judgments.reason: Chavarriaga & Millán 2010 reports the ErrP EEG recordings (same authors, 6 subjects, long-term stability) that make up BNCI 2015-013; dataset DOI points to this paper.
judgments.paper_title: Learning From EEG Error-Related Potentials in Noninvasive Brain-Computer Interfaces
judgments.paper_venue: IEEE Transactions on Neural Systems and Rehabilitation Engineering

judgments.reason: MNE-BIDS is a software tool for organizing electrophysiological data into BIDS, used to convert the dataset; it does not describe this ErrP dataset.
judgments.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
judgments.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software

judgments.reason: EEG-BIDS is a specification/extension of BIDS for EEG data, a standard used to organize this dataset, not a paper describing this error-related potentials dataset.
judgments.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
